meta.title: GenAI at work — extraction check — v4
meta.tagline: One exhibit per paper: the cells as printed against their units.
meta.description: The extraction-check workflow of the validation: for each paper one table or figure, drawn at random among those the estimates cite, with every cited cell as printed and the unit it was mapped to; the coder confirms value and mapping cell by cell, adds the cells the extraction missed, and can flag the paper for a full review. Taxonomy schema b5ed1ca67c; codebook in labeling/codebook.md.

fields.name: x_exhibit
fields.label: Exhibit
fields.help: the table or figure drawn for this paper, its page, its panels and the number of cited cells

fields.name: x_cells
fields.label: Cited cells
fields.help: one row per estimate read from this exhibit: the cell as printed and the unit it was mapped to

columns.name: arm_stats

columns.name: unit
columns.label: Unit
columns.help: task · arm vs reference · outcome · subgroup · horizon

columns.name: value_ok

columns.name: mapping_ok
columns.label: Mapping right?

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes

columns.name: text

fields.name: full_review
fields.label: Full review needed
fields.help: yes when what you saw makes the whole extraction of this paper doubtful; say why

stages.label: Cells
stages.help: One exhibit of this paper, drawn at random among those the extraction read estimates from; its transcription is in the pane, its page tag opens it in the PDF. For every row: is the value exactly as printed, and is the cell an estimate of the unit named? Add a row (＋) for a cell of this exhibit that estimates an AI-versus-reference contrast and is not listed (leave its Estimate blank). Press done; set *Full review needed* when what you saw makes the paper's whole extraction doubtful.
